conflicts.detail: Source says Media Carta 5.5x8.5 but bash used papersize=letter. Resolved with half-letter geometry.
Protocol names Arial/Times New Roman; container sample uses Arimo/Tinos equivalents. Mac/local script can be adjusted to exact fonts.
